title: Modular surface gradient and radius lattice for data-list controls
creator: Avery Zhang
description: Introduce a modular token set that layers a subtle surface gradient (tone-shift overlay) on top of semantic color ramps plus a parametric radius lattice for dense data-list and table controls. Goal: reduce perceived depth variance across mixed-density surfaces (compact lists, tables with row actions, and button groups) while preserving contrast and accessibility. This ticket covers token definitions, component variants, migration guidance, cross-team review, and a rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: New token set defined: semantic colors with 3 tone-shift overlays (neutral, accent, critical) and a radius lattice with 4 discrete steps mapped to density levels
Design files (Figma) include component variants for List, Table row, Primary/Secondary Button, and Card at Compact/Default/Dense densities
Automated token linter flags no usages of deprecated surface tokens and PR shows migration patch for top 10 highest-usage components
Contrast audits show text/button labels meet WCAG AA at all density levels with tone overlays applied
Console visual regression snapshots cover list and table permutations and pass baseline comparisons
engineering_notes: Runtime: runtime teams will need mapping from semantic token to model-specific kernel-friendly color variants for hosted vs private deployments
Recommend exposing density token as CSS custom property (--rwd-density-step) to allow runtime overrides for Dedicated/private deployments
Plan for deprecation: provide a compatibility layer that maps legacy tokens to new tone-shift overlays for 2 releases
Performance: gradient overlay is a single composited layer (opacity + multiply) to avoid rasterization on mobile
Backend: tag high-usage components via token-usage report to prioritize migration patches
decision_log: Chose tone-shift overlay (semantic overlay multiplied over base) instead of adding new base swatches to limit token explosion and simplify runtime quantization
Adopted a 4-step radius lattice (0, 4, 8, 12) mapped to density buckets rather than continuous radius to make migration easier and preserve consistent touch targets
Shadow approach: replaced large soft shadows with subtle layered penumbra + contrast offset to improve legibility on compact rows
Accessibility: kept text-on-surface contrast as primary constraint; overlaid tones adjust background but never reduce contrast below AA thresholds

Ship linter rule to block new usage of deprecated tokens after release-2

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: tone overlay could interact poorly with user-supplied backgrounds in embedded widgets. Mitigation: provide high-contrast 'isolation' surface token for embedded contexts
Risk: visual regressions across locales with longer labels in buttons. Mitigation: run internationalized screenshot tests and adjust padding for dense variants
